title: 第13章 鱼岭江坊市第14章 异石
content_zh:
“父...父亲。”
王伟阳小心翼翼的唤了一声。
王雄揉着眉头，心情糟糕到了极点。
王烈虽然天赋差，但再怎么说也是个聚气二重修士，对于普通人而言是降维打击般的存在。
平日里也能够为自己分担不少家族事务。
可如今，却是下落不明，生死未卜。
“叔叔可能只是被杨家关押囚禁了，不一定是...”
“哼！”
王雄冷哼一声：“你见过杨贯峰吗？”
“额...孩儿没有见过。”
“呵呵呵，那家伙就是一只吃人不吐骨头的恶狼！落在他手上，怎么可能还会有活路！”
王雄目露凶光，明显是和杨贯峰打过交道的。
王伟阳一听便有些犯怵：“那现在我们该怎么办？杨家不会上门兴师问罪吧？”
听到自己儿子说出这样没水平的话，王雄的内心顿时感到有些失望。
杨家怎么可能兴师问罪，那不是给他们倒打一耙的机会吗？
现在三天没动静，很明显杨家就是杀了你的人，然后当作无事发生，而王家还不能有任何不满，甚至问都不能问一嘴。
“唉...杨家不会来的，这次是我们栽在人家手上了。”
王雄无奈的叹息一声：“直到你弟弟回家探亲之前，你都不要离开白石镇，就在家中好好修炼，明白了吗？”
“明白，我知道了父亲。”
王伟阳走后，王雄脸上露出一丝疲惫。

他不像杨贯峰，身边有一位实力强劲又靠谱的余老辅佐。
王家能有今天的局面，都是他靠他一人撑起来的。
如今又折了一员大将，让他怎能不感到心烦意乱。
不过，在唏嘘一阵后，他的脸上又是露出些许欣慰之色。
好在他的两个儿子拥有修炼资质。
小儿子还被宗门看中，被秘密带上山去修炼，可以说前途一片大好。
“势不如人，就暂且忍耐退让一下吧。”
王雄作为一家之主，确实不缺乏定力和耐性。
王烈死后的第四天，杨家在白石镇的第四处商铺开业。
令众人没有想到的是，王家家主王雄竟然也亲自到场祝贺，他与杨家那位老修士似乎相见恨晚，相谈甚欢。
外人看来，王家是和杨家达成了某种合作。
但其中真正的原由，便只有他们几人心中清楚了。
小松山，杨家大院。
如今杨家的规模，已经比在柳叶镇时扩大了好几倍。
作为两镇之间的中转站，除了原先就有的商铺生意，杨家又开辟了数千亩田地，并且还开设了酒楼和驿站，供来往的商队吃饭休息。
这么一番操作下来，就让每日营收一下增长了四成，日子相较之前更加富裕了。
在运营农业和商业的同时，杨霄雷还在杨贯峰的授意下，练起了族兵。
以后杨家的势力规模和人口会愈发庞大，到时候不可能什么乱子都靠家族修士来出面解决。
修士是家族的最高战力，除了危及到家族生存的大危机，否则不可轻易下场。
杨贯峰将王烈私闯禁地的事情告诉了余老。

余老对他的处理方式没有意见，但关于陈阳的事情，他也有些拿不准。
content_en:
"Father...Father."
Wang Weiyang called out cautiously.
Wang Xiong rubbed his brow, feeling extremely bad.
Although Wang Lie has poor talent, he is still a second-level Qi gathering monk. To ordinary people, he is like a dimension-reducing blow.
On weekdays, I can also share a lot of family affairs for myself.
But now, his whereabouts are unknown, and his life or death is uncertain.
"Uncle may just be imprisoned by the Yang family, not necessarily..."
"Hmph!"
Wang Xiong snorted coldly: "Have you seen Yang Guanfeng?"
"Um...I haven't seen the child before."
"Hahaha, that guy is just a vicious wolf that eats people without spitting out their bones! How could he still survive if he fell into his hands!"
Wang Xiong's eyes showed a fierce look, he had obviously dealt with Yang Guanfeng.
Wang Weiyang was a little frightened when he heard this: "Then what should we do now? The Yang family won't come to ask for help, right?"
Wang Xiong suddenly felt a little disappointed when he heard his son say such incompetent words.
How could the Yang family raise an army to hold them accountable? Wouldn't that give them a chance to defeat them?
There has been no movement for three days. It is obvious that the Yang family is the one who killed you and then pretended that nothing happened. However, the Wang family cannot have any dissatisfaction and cannot even ask.
"Sigh... The Yang family won't come. This time we fell into someone else's hands."
Wang Xiong sighed helplessly: "Until your brother comes home to visit relatives, you should not leave Baishi Town and just practice well at home. Do you understand?"
"Understood, I understand father."
After Wang Weiyang left, Wang Xiong showed a trace of exhaustion on his face.
Unlike Yang Guanfeng, he has a strong and reliable assistant named Yu.
The Wang family is in today's situation only because of him.
Now that another general had been lost, how could he not feel upset.
However, after sighing for a while, his face showed some relief.
Fortunately, his two sons have cultivation qualifications.
The younger son was also favored by the sect and was secretly taken to the mountains to practice. It can be said that he has a bright future.
"You are outnumbered, so just be patient and give in for the time being."
As the head of the family, Wang Xiong does not lack determination and patience.
On the fourth day after Wang Lie's death, the Yang family's fourth store in Baishi Town opened.
What everyone didn't expect was that Wang Xiong, the head of the Wang family, also came to congratulate him in person. He and the old monk from the Yang family seemed to have met each other late and had a pleasant conversation.
From the outside, it seems that the Wang family has reached some kind of cooperation with the Yang family.
But only a few of them knew the real reason.
Xiaosongshan, the Yang family compound.
Today, the size of the Yang family has expanded several times compared to when it was in Liuye Town.
As a transfer station between the two towns, in addition to the original shop business, the Yang family opened up thousands of acres of farmland, and also opened restaurants and inns for the traveling caravans to eat and rest.
After such operations, the daily revenue increased by 40%, and life became richer than before.
While running agriculture and commerce, Yang Xiaolei also trained clan soldiers under the instruction of Yang Guanfeng.
In the future, the Yang family's power and population will become larger and larger, and it will be impossible to rely on the family monks to resolve all problems.
The monks are the highest fighting force of the family. Unless there is a major crisis that endangers the survival of the family, they should not be dismissed easily.
Yang Guanfeng told Mr. Yu about Wang Lie's private invasion of the forbidden area.
Mr. Yu had no objection to his handling of the matter, but he was also a little unsure about Chen Yang.
